outputs: Generated textual answers to mathematical reasoning problems
The generated outputs are model responses to mathematical reasoning questions in a zero-shot learning setting, where the model is prompted to generate answers to math word problems.

changes_made.explanation: Added missing commonsense reasoning datasets from Appendix A. Normalized task names to title case. No changes to models or outputs as they were correctly extracted.
Simplified 'accuracy' to 'Accuracy' using consistent capitalization. The paper only uses accuracy as an automatic metric.
Removed placeholder 'None' values since no LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The paper uses only automatic metrics and no post-generation LLM evaluation.
Removed placeholder 'None' values since no human evaluation was conducted. The paper relies solely on automatic accuracy metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods and evaluates them on mathematical reasoning and commonsense inference tasks using only accuracy as an automatic metric. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used. The metadata extraction was mostly accurate, missing only some datasets mentioned in the appendix.
